Name: Race
Title: Race
Description: **Deprecation Information:** Deprecated per UP-263. This code system is NOT the acknowledged source of truth for Race concepts and codes. It should no longer be used. https://terminology.hl7.org/en/ECS_MR-CDCREC.html contains information on what should be used in its place. In the United States, federal standards for classifying data on race determine the categories used by federal agencies and exert a strong influence on categorization by state and local agencies and private sector organizations. The federal standards do not conceptually define race, and they recognize the absence of an anthropological or scientific basis for racial classification. Instead, the federal standards acknowledge that race is a social-political construct in which an individual's own identification with one more race categories is preferred to observer identification. The standards use a variety of features to define five minimum race categories. Among these features are descent from "the original peoples" of a specified region or nation. The minimum race categories are American Indian or Alaska Native, Asian, Black or African American, Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander, and White. The federal standards stipulate that race data need not be limited to the five minimum categories, but any expansion must be collapsible to those categories.

Description: Consolidated PH Core terminology for PRC CPDAS Council codes, CPDAS numerical profession codes, and PRC licensure examination codes. CPDAS council and profession concepts reflect the FAQ as of 12 January 2021; PRC examination concepts reflect the standardized list posted 18 March 2026. The hierarchy groups related concepts and does not assert an is-a relationship. The 2021 CPDAS table says its numeric profession codes are for CPD attendance sheets and is subject to regular updating. The 2026 Food Technology and Speech-Language Pathology examination boards have abstract local grouping nodes because the 2021 CPDAS table has no council codes for them; those nodes are not CouncilCode values.
